column1: # What became of each disc file no module is made from: PATTERN, TREATMENT, then the evidence, TAB-separated.
# saturn-recomp/src/saturnrecomp/inventory.py reads it; the first row that matches wins. Files no row
# matches are reported as unknown: give one a row only with evidence for it. "Read on Beetle" is the
# 2026-10-13 record of the CD sectors the real BIOS and game read (build/agent-runs/2a-disc-reads,
# agent-home projects/pc-saturnbomberman/context/inventory.md): boot, the normal route and the battle route.

column3: saturn-recomp's boot (runtime bios.cpp) reads its header and loads the first-read file; its security and area code are not run. It differs from SAMPLEIP.BIN, the IP module's source, in 123 bytes from 0xE2 to 0xEAA.
CD-DA: the runtime's CD block plays a track when the game asks (runs log "CD-DA: play track N").

SEGA's 68000 sound driver (Ver2.04 96/01/25, Sound Division): 180 68000 rts, no SH-2 return. Read on Beetle to 0x00254000 at boot. In our run its bytes from 0x44 are sound RAM from 0 at VBlank 2500 (30,416 of 32,768 equal; the rest is its work area), and the 68000 runs it on Musashi.

Images the CPU reads into 0x00200000-0x002F0000 on Beetle (0x8000-0x1C8000, 0x438000-0x4D4000, 0x66C000-0x6D4000, 0x900000-0x968000 in the routes recorded). No SH-2 prologue or return in any part read, and KRNL names 0x00254000 only from a table.
Sega FILM with Cinepak video (cvid); on Beetle the master's DMA streams it into a ring buffer at 0x060C341C for KRNL to decode (BOMSS1 the attract intro, BOMSS2 the Normal Game story).
AIFF (FORM...AIFF), all 19. On Beetle, SCU DMA streams M_007 (normal) and M_021, M_025 (battle) whole into a 0x5000-byte ring buffer at 0x060CE730; the other 16 were not read in the routes recorded.
A 68-byte table of directory names (BOMSS, XBAND); read on Beetle to 0x00278120 at boot.
A 288-byte record naming SATURN BOMBERMAN; read on Beetle to 0x00278000 at boot.
